SS21.name: 寂静鲳
SS21.form: a deep oval body, a small head, a short blunt snout, a small mouth, a still even surface with faint packed ring seams
SS21.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS21.markings: a set of still concentric rings across the flank, a single resting ripple band near the nape
SS21.colour: 静灰底、年轮暗线、冷银腹面

SS22.name: 霜鳞鲑
SS22.form: a streamlined spindle-shaped body, a small head, a short snout, a terminal mouth, crystalline scales with clean cut edges
SS22.fins: a short dorsal fin, a slightly forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS22.markings: an even row of frost-like facet points along the flank, a faint arc above the lateral line
SS22.colour: 冰蓝底、霜晶银面、脊线冷白

SS23.name: 幻影鲽
SS23.form: a flattened oval body, both eyes on one side, a small upturned mouth, a translucent body with faint sheen, a low even fringe along the margin
SS23.fins: a long dorsal fin and anal fin fringing the body, a rounded tail fin
SS23.markings: a soft diffuse outline along the flank, faint bands crossing the eyed side
SS23.colour: 雾蓝底、幻影灰晕、鳍缘透明

SS24.name: 星屑海马
SS24.form: an upright narrow body with evenly ringed segments, a long tubular snout, a small mouth, a curled tail, a row of tiny luminous specks
SS24.fins: a small dorsal fin, tiny pectoral fins, no tail fin
SS24.markings: an even row of luminous specks along the ringed segments, a spot behind the eye
SS24.colour: 暗金底、星屑银点、环纹冷灰

SS25.name: 陨光鮟鱇
SS25.form: a stout rounded body with faceted bump plates, a large head, a wide gaping mouth with even teeth, a slender lure rising from the snout
SS25.fins: a low dorsal fin, small rounded pectoral fins, a rounded tail fin
SS25.markings: a single glowing bead at the lure tip, a faint seam along the jaw
SS25.colour: 深褐底、陨光青点、吻前微荧

SS26.name: 幽蓝鳞鲀
SS26.form: a deep angular oval body with faceted plate scales, a large head, a small terminal mouth, a stout dorsal spine, a pointed snout
SS26.fins: a dorsal fin with a stout front spine, a rounded tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS26.markings: a band across the eye, a faint seam along the flank plates
SS26.colour: 幽蓝底、暗青棱面、眼周冷线

SS27.name: 星砂鲽
SS27.form: a flattened oval body, both eyes on one side, a small mouth, fine grains fused into a faceted eyed-side skin
SS27.fins: a long dorsal fin and anal fin fringing the body, a rounded tail fin
SS27.markings: a scatter of luminous grains across the eyed side, a faint arc behind the head
SS27.colour: 砂褐底、星砂银粒、盲侧苍白

SS28.name: 陨纹金枪
SS28.form: a robust spindle-shaped body, a pointed head, a large mouth, fine faceted scales, a row of finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins
SS28.fins: a long dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets
SS28.markings: broken crater-like streaks along the flank, a single seam near the gill cover
SS28.colour: 铁蓝底、陨纹铜斑、腹部冷银

SS29.name: 夜穹旗鱼
SS29.form: a slender spindle-shaped body, a long pointed bill, a small mouth, a row of luminous pits along the flank
SS29.fins: a tall sail-like dorsal fin with even upright spines, a deeply forked tail fin, slender pelvic fins
SS29.markings: a row of luminous pits along the flank, a faint line behind the eye
SS29.colour: 夜蓝底、穹顶银线、鳍膜幽光

SS30.name: 星耀鲹
SS30.form: a moderately deep fusiform body, a steep forehead, a small mouth, a compact head, faceted flank plates
SS30.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins
SS30.markings: a scatter of luminous points along the upper flank, a spot on the gill cover
SS30.colour: 银蓝底、星耀白点、背缘深靛
